command.help:
#### Group Ring
Ring people to join a call. The call is started in the channel (or joined if one is already running), and every recipient sees an incoming call with Accept and Decline.

* `/ring @alice @bob` rings the listed members of this channel.
* `/ring @channel` rings all members of this channel.
* `/ring ~channel-name` rings all members of another channel in this team and starts the call there.
* `/ring --confirm ...` skips the confirmation for large rings.
* `/ring --cancel` stops your latest ring.
* `/ring --help` shows this help.

People who are offline, or who have no Mattermost web or desktop session open, get a direct message with a link to the call.
